name: radio-group
description: A single-select control used within a radio group, with Basic row and Choice card layouts.

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat data-[state=open]/focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

accessibility.screenReaderName: Visible label text is the accessible name. Use fieldset and legend for group label.
accessibility.focusIndicator: Basic uses color/ring on radio circle. Choice card uses color/border/focus on card border.
accessibility.focusCheckedOverlap: Radix RadioGroup couples arrow-key focus movement with selection (native radio interaction model). On Choice card, once a group has a selected value, arrowing to another card sets Checked and Focus simultaneously — the card border shows brand/primary (Checked) and border/focus (Focus) at the same time, making the two states visually indistinguishable in practice. The pure Focus (non-Checked) border is only reachable when the group has no selection yet (first Tab into an empty group). The Basic type's radio circle ring (color/ring, 2px OUTSIDE) remains independently visible regardless of checked state.
accessibility.touchTarget: Choice cards meet 44px target; Basic rows require min-height 44px wrapper.

constraints: Never use a single radio-item in isolation.
Use checkbox when only one option exists.
Choice cards are transparent and must not receive a fill.
Use Type=Choice card only when the option needs more explanation or visual weight.

useCases: Pricing plan selection: Free, Plus, Pro — only one tier can be active, seeing all options at once matters
Subscription billing cadence: Monthly, Yearly, Lifetime — 3 visible options, mutual exclusion is the entire point
Notification delivery preference: Email, SMS, Push — user picks one channel
Layout or display mode selector: Grid view, List view, Compact view
Feedback form rating scale: Poor, Fair, Good, Excellent — visible options help calibrate the choice

Type=Basic.whenToUse: Compact preference list in a form or settings panel — low visual weight, options are self-explanatory

Type=Choice card.whenToUse: Each option warrants a title + description, or the choice carries enough visual weight to justify a card
examples: Onboarding goal (For personal use / For my team)

comparedTo.situation: 2–5 mutually exclusive options where seeing all at once aids the decision
User can pick multiple options from the list
Each option is a major feature tier with rich description

openQuestions: Radio.md Token Bindings says Invalid text uses color/text/invalid, while Behavior says text stays default. Confirm the correct Invalid text behavior.
notes: Examples assume RadioGroupItem and RadioItem wrapper APIs.
Figma R1–R8 audit passed 2026-05-28 — 0 issues across radio (5v) and radio-item (10v).

changelog.change: Invalid state: focus ring uses color/border/error instead of color/ring.

ChoiceCard story: added missing focus-within:border-[var(--color-border-focus)] on the card wrapper to match Radio.md spec. Documented Focus/Checked overlap caveat — on Choice card, arrow-key navigation moves focus and selection together, so the dedicated Focus border is usually masked by the Checked border.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
